title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: GWR Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal - Norwich

A Solicitors firm in Norwich is looking to recruit a paralegal to their residential Conveyancing team.

This role will entail working alongside lawyers in the Residential Property team, ensuring an efficient and high level of service is provided in progressing conveyancing transactions.

Experience of working as a Legal Secretary, conveyancing assistant or paralegal in residential conveyancing must be shown in order to be considered for this position.

The firm will provide an environment where you can really continue to develop in this specialist area. They invest time and money in training in order to ensure all their people can progress and continue to professionally develop.

The conveyancing team is a busy and thriving team, however they are not a high volume type of environment. There is a definite quality over quantity approach taken and the team regularly deal with high value transactions.

If you are a conveyancing assistant/paralegal looking for a new challenge where you can really advance your career, whilst working on interesting and varied work then this role is worth consideration.

The firm is looking to interview ASAP so if this is of interest please apply using the links or get in touch with Greg at GWR Legal for further details

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Criminal Legal Secretary

Kings Lynn, Norfolk

Competitive Salary Full-Time Permanent

A well-established and respected law firm in Kings Lynn is seeking an experienced Criminal Legal Secretary to join its busy and supportive team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and organised legal secretary who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in providing exceptional administrative support.

The Role

Working closely with solicitors and fee earners, you will be responsible for:
- Audio and copy typing of legal documents and correspondence
- Managing client communications and enquiries
- Liaising with courts, barristers, police stations and external parties
- Diary management and arranging appointments
- Preparing legal documents and court bundles
- Opening and closing client files
- Maintaining accurate records and case management systems
- General secretarial and administrative support to the Criminal Law department

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, ideally within Criminal Law
- Excellent audio typing and document production skills
- Strong organisational and time management abilities
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- A professional and confidential approach to work
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Opportunity to work for a reputable local law firm
- Long-term career prospects and development opportunities
- Generous holiday entitlement and additional staff benefits

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly regarded legal practice where your contribution will be valued and where you can continue to develop your legal secretarial career within criminal law.

To apply or find out more, please contact Michelle Topley at Reed Legal on or email your CV to
